# aptabase_app (Data Source)

Looks up a single aptabase-plus app by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aptabase_app" "example" {
  id = "existing-app-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) App ID.

### Read-Only

- `app_key` (String, Sensitive) SDK ingestion key for this app.
- `name` (String) App name.
